description:
Electric bikes in Pakistan have revolutionised the way that people commute. With the increasing traffic congestion and fuel costs, more riders are looking into electric alternatives that can be eco-friendly and economical. In this category, the Yadea EPOCH is a standout in everyday use.
The electric scooter combines sleek design, durable performance, and innovative features to make urban travel easier. As more and more people move towards environmentally friendly transportation and a more sustainable lifestyle, the EPOCH is becoming a popular option for riders who seek convenience, efficiency, and style.
How beneficial is it for you?
Making the switch to an electric scooter isn't only about saving fuel but also about embracing the latest technology and convenience. Yadea EPOCH offers smooth rides and little maintenance, as well as speedy charging at home.
Battery 72V 38 Ah Graphene Battery
Technology Yadea Motor
Range 125 Km/Hr. on a single charge
Max Speed 70 Km/Hr.
Charge Time 7-8 hours
Rated Power 2000 W and 3200W Peak Power
People who commute daily in bustling cities understand that cities need more peaceful and noise-free rides. It's an upgrade to traditional two-wheelers that offer functionality and a beneficial environmental impact.
Your Ride, Your Buddy
EPOH is an unbeatable ride that is highly user-friendly and comfortable. The style and elegance it delivers when you are out on the street is unbeatable. After seeing its high performance and battery timing, one would think it would be heavy, but on the contrary, it's lightweight, stable, and makes your glide through traffic easier than ever.
Your buddy ride’s efficiency can cut down on overall commute time and provide a relaxing and stress-free method of moving about. Due to their eco-friendly nature, they are quickly growing in popularity among urban inhabitants.
E-scooter bike
Most of the crowd is wondering what an e-scooter bike is. Is it a bike or a scooter? What is this new terminology? Well, our vehicles are designed to give the sleekness of bikes, the stability of a scooter, and the efficiency of an e-bike. This is why it has the hybrid name EPOCH Scooter E-bike , as it offers the best of both worlds; it needs less storage space, has lower operating costs, and a stylish and sleek design. The EPOCH is a hybrid of the speed and agility of a scooter and the convenience of a commuter bike, which makes it a very versatile option.
Electric Motorcycle Scooter Features
Electric motorcycle scooters are engineered to provide performance and convenience, and the EPOCH is no different.

Maximum load capacity 140 kg

Together, these features provide a stable everyday ride that's ready to go for short trips to the store or regular commutes to work.
Battery Scooty in Pakistan
A battery scooter in Pakistan needs to be equipped with qualities that can endure the situation. EPOCH provides cutting-edge battery technology that can survive the heat of summer and the cold winter nights. It is easy to charge it by plugging it into an office or home socket. Its durability and efficiency make it ideal for frequent riders looking for an effective companion for their daily commutes. For commuters in urban areas, this is a reliable battery that is low-maintenance.
Eco-Friendly Scooty Advantages
A scooty that is eco-friendly, like the Yadea EPOCH, does more than just save costs; it also protects the environment.
